text.A: **Ši politika taikoma, kad ir kur būtumėte.** Laikomės JK duomenų apsaugos teisės, o kai taip pat taikoma šalies, kurioje gyvenate, duomenų apsaugos teisė, laikomės ir jos.
text.B: **Pastabos apie alergijas ir mitybą.** Perduodame jas furgonui kartu su jūsų užsakymu ir niekam kitam jų nenaudojame. Jas kartu su jūsų vardu ir kontaktiniais duomenimis pašaliname praėjus 12 mėnesių po užsakymo (žr. 7 skyrių).
text.C: **Tarptautiniai perdavimai.** Jūsų paskyros duomenys ir užsakymų duomenys saugomi ir tvarkomi Jungtinėje Karalystėje. Kai kurie dalykai tvarkomi už jos ribų: meniu nuskaitymas ir WhatsApp automatiniai atsakymai, kuriems naudojama Google paslauga Jungtinėse Amerikos Valstijose; WhatsApp žinučių pristatymas, kurį atlieka Meta Jungtinėse Amerikos Valstijose; mokėjimai, kuriuos tvarko Stripe Jungtinėse Amerikos Valstijose; ir tiesioginiai pranešimai, kuriuos pristato Apple ir Google Jungtinėse Amerikos Valstijose. Kai duomenys perduodami už JK ribų, perdavimui taikomi JK tinkamumo reglamentai (UK adequacy regulations) arba International Data Transfer Agreement (Tarptautinio duomenų perdavimo sutartis) ar Addendum (Priedas), o kai to reikalauja jūsų šalies teisė, – ir tos teisės pripažįstama apsaugos priemonė. Galite paprašyti mūsų informacijos apie taikomas apsaugos priemones.
text.G:
Mūsų [Paslaugų teikimo sąlygos](/terms) taikomos kiekvienoje šalyje, kurioje naudojama HatchGrab. Kai kuriose šalyse taikomos papildomos taisyklės. Šiame puslapyje jos pateikiamos atskirai kiekvienai šaliai.

Jei toliau pateiktas skirsnis taikomas jums, jis yra mūsų Paslaugų teikimo sąlygų dalis. Jei jame nustatyta kitaip nei jose, tai šaliai taikomas šis puslapis.

Jei jūsų šalies sąraše nėra, papildomų taisyklių nėra: Paslaugų teikimo sąlygos taikomos taip, kaip parašyta. Mūsų [Privatumo politika](/privacy) visose šalyse yra ta pati.

back.A: **This policy applies wherever you may be.** We comply with UK data protection law, and when the data protection law of the country you live in also applies, we comply with that too.
back.B: **Notes about allergies and diet.** We pass them to the truck together with your order and use them for nothing else. We remove them together with your name and contact details 12 months after the order (see section 7).
back.C: ...or Addendum (Addendum), and when the law of your country requires it, also by a safeguard recognised by that law.
back.D: Intro: Under UK data protection law and, when it applies, the law of the country you live in, you have the right to: [bullets unchanged]. / The law of the country you live in may give you these rights under other names or give additional rights. You have those too. / **Making a request.** Write to privacy@hatchgrab.com. Before taking action, we will check whether the request is genuine. You can ask another person to make the request for you, and we will not treat you differently because you made a request. We will reply within one month or sooner if the law of your country requires it. If you ordered from a truck, we may pass your request to that truck, because it decides how your order details are used. If we refuse a request, you can ask us to review it again by replying to our answer. / **Deleting the account.** [unchanged] + When an operator's account is deleted, we also remove its customers' names, contact details and notes from the orders we keep. / **Marketing emails.** We send marketing emails only when the law of the country you live in allows it, and in some countries this means only with your consent. Each one states who it is sent from, gives our postal address and says how to stop receiving them. If you ask us to stop, we will do so free of charge and within 10 working days. Emails about an order or your account are not marketing. If we or a truck offer order updates by text message, you will get them only if you agree, and you can stop them at any time. / **If something goes wrong.** If a breach involving your personal data may cause you serious harm, then where the law requires it we will tell you and the supervisory authority as soon as possible, or help the truck you ordered from to do so. / **Complaints.** First contact us at privacy@hatchgrab.com; we would be grateful for the chance to put things right. You can also complain to the data protection supervisory authority of the country you live in. In the UK, that is the Information Commissioner's Office (UK Information Commissioner's Office): website ico.org.uk, telephone 0303 123 1113.
back.G: Our [Terms of Service] apply in every country where HatchGrab is used. In some countries additional rules apply. This page sets them out separately for each country. / If a section below applies to you, it forms part of our Terms of Service. If it provides otherwise than they do, this page applies for that country. / If your country is not on the list, there are no additional rules: the Terms of Service apply as written. Our [Privacy Policy] is the same in all countries.
